title: Will Cleveland win the 2026 NBA Eastern Conference Finals?
rules: Resolves YES if Cleveland wins the 2026 NBA Eastern Conference Finals series. Resolves NO otherwise.

title: Will the May 2026 US CPI print come in below 3.0% year-over-year?
rules: Resolves YES if the BLS-reported May 2026 CPI YoY is below 3.0%, otherwise NO.

title: Which country will win Eurovision 2026?
rules: Resolves to the country whose contestant wins the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest.
